root_integration.scope: Only exact B2 seal_none wait1 acknowledgement; new seal_execution_host_v1 remains in ordinary failure/wait checks.

checks: Independently read full helper, diagnosis, main-host failure observation, exact deployment plan, original native.seal body, and current root metadata_revision_guard integration. Local source parsing and pin checks only; no helper/remote/test/production execution.

Original B2 seal actually failed with integer 1 before its first output write. Exact original five control files, source, registration, three PID/start generations and pinned main-host gone observation are retained; the earlier phase failure remains unchanged. The acknowledgement explicitly preserves failure and is not a synthetic wait0.

Current root integration pins helper bytes, obtains only its code fragment from checked source, applies the branch only for B2 seal_none, and includes the new control in ordinary unknown-failure/actual-wait checks. All other root suffix checks remain in place.

Run requires the correct leo host, same phase registration, registered native source, both native workers and controllers closed using execution-host observations, no new failures, absent five seal outputs, absent new control/route, and nonzero ARPC jobs with that phase own configuration.

Runtime metadata interpreter/Torch/package descriptors are verified on leo where they originated. Exact policy, metadata-only qualification wait, model reference canonical runtime, registration/public identity and all immutable production sources remain bound.

Only original CPY -B native.py seal is invoked once with CUDA hidden and 1800-second true wait. No receiver, VAR, decoder, metric, channel, training, or bootstrap role is dispatched. Original seal reads closed pixels/truth only for post-exit audit and never repairs receiver outputs from truth.

Exclusive adaptive execution lock and new control preserve stdout/stderr, actual host/PID/start, exact argv and helper/source pins. Unknown failure is saved and stops without automatic retry or next stage.

Separate observe requires real strict wait0, exact child/controller relation and argv, child/controller/outer-parent gone on leo, no new failure, completed native manifest and every manifest descriptor. Only then writes host observation and success route.

B3 uses its own phase registration/configuration and fresh outputs; the B2 failed predecessor is not transferred to B3. A phase with zero new ARPC calls explicitly stops for a separate metadata route instead of inventing inference.
limitations: This is engineering qualification, not a successful relocated seal or B2/B3 scientific completion. Root must still verify absent outputs/actual current process state through the reviewed entry and perform explicit run then observe.
Final report/publisher must consume the new actual success route and execution-host observation while disclosing original MAIN wait1. Original failed receipts must not be relabelled or removed.
Local runtime binaries are intentionally host-specific; their raw expected descriptors in diagnosis do not authorize main-host substitution.
